result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6517). It's the same filter the quarter report uses.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*SalesRepPurchase*'`, which finished with no output and no failures. I didn't check how many tests that pattern matched, and I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
